title: TGT-D29: the aux_upb focuser poll publishes FOCUSER_POSITION and FOCUSER_STEPS OK over a queued request when SI reports no motion
summary: TGT-D29 (alias from the retired indigo_drivers/REVIEW_SWITCH_TARGETS.md): the aux_upb focuser on_timer sets FOCUSER_POSITION and FOCUSER_STEPS OK when SI reports no motion without checking for a queued request. A position request whose handler has not sent the move yet is shown OK, and a FOCUSER_STEPS request that should be refused as overlapping is accepted. Seen as the intermittent focuser_overlapping_request_is_rejected failure (2 of 3 runs on 3.0.0.34, 2 of 9 on 3.0.0.35); still open in driver version 38. Next action: a scoped aux_upb repair task that leaves BUSY focuser properties to their pending handler in the SI branch, with a deterministic regression test.

resolution.evidence: 20261025211159-e308-fix-audit-findings-batch/verification.md and group-reports.md: aux_upb bb697e6aa (v39) and 1619d4243: SI no-motion poll leaves queued BUSY requests to the handler, abort ends a cancelled request in ALERT; focuser_poll_leaves_a_queued_request_busy; 52/52.
